text:
maya: Quick sync  OrionEdge committed to a 20m case interview + short webinar next Thu 10:30am PT. Need legal on quote clearance, logo permission, and embargo window. Also routing webinar signups to an SDR queue 'orionedge-webinar'.

liam: I'll handle recording + clips. Please paste verbatim quote candidates so legal can pre-check.

kate: From notes (verbatim; will confirm on mic):
"Moving inference to Redwood Dedicated cut our P95 from ~300ms to ~170ms under load."
"Batching + KV cache reduced GPU spend by around 41% in our pilot."
"Rollout was frictionless  we shipped without extra infra changes."

courtney: Legal flag  percent claims need a metrics snapshot or written confirmation. Logo use requires a signed logo release. If they prefer, we can publish quotes + company name but anonymize UI screenshots. I'll draft a one-paragraph release and a redaction checklist.

maya: Sample SFDC webhook payload for routing (auth omitted):

POST /hooks/sfdc HTTP/1.1
Host: hooks.redwood.example
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "source": "orionedge-webinar",
  "email": "{registrant_email}",
  "first_name": "{registrant_first}",
  "last_name": "{registrant_last}",
  "utm_campaign": "orionedge-launch",
  "target_queue": "OrionEdge Webinar"
}

liam: I'll capture separate takes for each line and add a consent checkbox to the invite. Also will flag timestamps after the recording.

maya: Customer requested embargo: earliest publish 2026-11-05 08:00 PT. Courtney, can legal sign off by 11/01 EOD?

courtney: Yes  I'll review the quote text today and send redlines. If metrics are needed, ask OrionEdge infra to provide a screenshot or CSV.

ops-bot: Calendar invite "OrionEdge case interview" created by liam for 2026-10-30 10:30 PT. Recording enabled.

maya: Great  next steps: 1) get metrics snapshot or adjust wording (owner: orionedge), 2) legal sign-off & logo release (owner: courtney), 3) release signed & assets uploaded (owner: liam), 4) landing page + webhook test (owner: demand gen). Ping here when done. :rocket:
